## Audience

::: {.detail-list}
- **Audience:** PhD students, postdocs and researchers in life sciences, healthcare and related fields
- **Background:** Basic R experience needed
- **Eligibility:** Swedish applicants are prioritized; international applicants are welcome
:::
:::

::: {.details-section}
## Registration and fees

::: {.detail-list}
- **Announcements:** Published on [SciLifeLab Training](https://training.scilifelab.se/) a few months in advance
- **Online:** Free for academia; industry participants pay a fee
- **On-site:** Fees apply to all and include lunch, coffee breaks and a course dinner
- **Logistics:** Arrange your own travel and accommodation; bring a laptop
- **Billing:** An institutional reference is required; NBIS cannot invoice individuals
:::
:::
:::
